sentences: q15 is a real miss. The answer names the 093N034 on 34595's title page but not the 093N043 on 36807's. That session never opened 36807's title page, and the map sheet session opened neither, so the card shows 093N only because the q15 session found one of them.
q08 is a scorer miss, not a wrong answer. The answer says "toward the northeast" and "a deeper hole", and the scorer only accepts the report's own words, so it can't tell a paraphrase from a gap.

Code can only compare what the agent claims. Reading 41800 p37 by hand turns up two more disagreements no session claimed: Table 4 gives IL-23-26 40 ppb gold where the text gives 47 ppb, and the text says IL-23-025 stopped at 717 m while Table 4 runs its composite to 750.00 m.

Code checks the numbers in the summary, not its words. Sentence 8 lists IL-22-20 among the disagreements, though it is one row whose width doesn't match its own depths, and sentence 9 says "the other reports" where 36807's own p3 and p9 are among them. Every number in both is right; the notes on the card mark the words. A geologist's read would catch slips like these.
The checker threw out 22 of 550 proposed claims, mostly values the agent tidied instead of copying, and the agent fixed 17 of them after reading the reason.
